details.method: For model-authored designs consumed by a native parser, expose one canonical pending-confirmation template and validate it with that actual parser. Report specific structural errors instead of assuming normal prose will fit the hidden input contract.
details.when: The editor generates a design document that the same editor consumes for dependency-based production.
details.counterexample: Human-only prose without a machine consumer does not need rigid headings; a parsed document still does not grant execution authority or replace explicit confirmation.
details.trial_plan: On the next formally installed editor, run actual native design UI checks for the shared valid template and observed malformed headings/dependencies; require actionable errors, no unauthorized dispatch and retained stale-confirmation rejection.
